nodes.label: 19-Layer Data Pipeline
nodes.rationale: Each of the 19 source layers is independent and wrapped in try/except so one failure never blocks the rest (graceful degradation); freshness is recorded after each successful layer. 14 of 19 layers run with zero API keys.

nodes.label: Briefing Package (orchestrator + 26 sections + BriefingData)
nodes.rationale: The 1,492-LOC briefing monolith was split into a package: one module per section exposing format(), an orchestrator that joins them, and a frozen BriefingData dataclass so consumers can render one section at a time. generate_briefing() is a thin wrapper returning BriefingData.text so existing callers keep working.

nodes.label: Front-Month Roll-Day Discontinuity (Known Limitation)
nodes.rationale: yfinance silently switches underlying contracts near expiry, creating artificial price gaps on roll days. Technicals and signals propagate the discontinuity; mitigation demotes signals within +/-3 business days of an estimated roll date to info severity tagged (near-roll). Spreads/basis largely cancel the artifact. Deferred fix: Panama-adjusted adj_close column with a dual-column read pattern (technicals adjusted, spreads/basis raw).

nodes.label: Anti-Bot Wall Layer Disablement (NCDEX + CEPEA)
nodes.rationale: Layer 16 (NCDEX) is blocked by a JS fingerprint interstitial (__hd_fingerprint cookie via /__verify/fp); Layer 17 (CEPEA) by a Cloudflare Turnstile challenge (HTTP 403). Both are short-circuited in main.py via _mark_empty with diagnostic logging so the wall is visible, and fetcher code is preserved. Re-enabling needs alternate sources or a Playwright bypass, not a URL update.
